newsitem.title: CHINA: Haixing starts domestic container route.
newsitem.headline: Haixing starts domestic container route.

text.p: Shanghai Haixing Shipping Co Ltd, one of China's largest shipping firms, will start a domestic container express shipping service along the eastern coast from April 5, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The express shipping service will first link Shanghai with the southern ports of Guangzhou and Xiamen, the spokesman said, adding that the route will later be extended to coastal cities in north China.
Large high-speed container ships, each with a capacity of 600 containers capacity, will be used on the route, he said.

"International competition is too severe, so we are turning our focus to the domestic market," the spokesman said. "The domestic container shipping market is growing fast and we believe the new business will be a new source of profits."
The company, a subsidiary of Shanghai Ocean Shipping (Group) Company, currently operates 170 ships.
